rule: IMPLEMENTED means the named executable guard exists now; PENDING means a later 02C sub-slice still owns the hazard.

entries.hazard: Raw Playwright storage state escapes protected runtime into durable artifacts.
Treat gitignore as sufficient secret protection.
Encode identity, token, path, or provider material in opaque session refs.
Accept caller-controlled raw storage-state paths.
Automate the user's default browser profile.
Treat user_data_dir as a normal promotable or cloud-synced artifact.
Reuse one persistent browser profile concurrently without an exclusive lease.
Attach to an arbitrary existing browser or CDP endpoint because it is reachable.
Treat CDP attachment as the cross-browser shared-core transport.
Restore a session without exact-origin revalidation.
Treat authenticated state as inherited mutation authority.
Expose model-visible password, MFA, recovery-code, or passkey entry parameters.
Keep durable screenshots, traces, request bodies, headers, or unsafe console capture active during secret entry.
Use unbounded debug pause or timeout-zero semantics for production takeover.
Persist sessionStorage through arbitrary JavaScript or environment/file side channels.
Persist real-user virtual WebAuthn credentials or private keys by default.
Restore virtual WebAuthn state without accounting for virtual-authenticator side effects.
Assume cookies/localStorage represent complete auth state and omit IndexedDB capability accounting.
Blindly retry expired, revoked, or unavailable auth state.
Guess credentials or escalate authentication after failure.
Allow SSO redirects to silently widen admitted origins.
Log raw cookies, tokens, or raw site-session identifiers for correlation.
Trust cookie flags or SameSite as proof of declared identity context.
Keep reusable authenticated state indefinitely without explicit expiry.
Reseal state after a privilege or risk boundary without fresh verification.
Fall back to plaintext when the protected backend is unavailable.
Treat any installed keyring backend as equivalently secure and admitted.
Expose protected-store paths, profile directories, tokens, or raw state in receipts.
Allow cancelled takeover to leave reusable partial auth state.
Treat logout as page navigation without invalidating the reusable local session.
